verdict.rationale: Adyen's Management API supports ordering terminals via API (adyen-pos-docs-11) and the docs mention managing terminals from a unified Customer Area (adyen-pos-docs-3), showing some programmatic fleet-related capability. However, there is no evidence of API endpoints for registering devices, monitoring real-time device status, or remotely pushing configuration updates — these appear to be handled through the Customer Area UI rather than API. Missing for 10: API-based device registration, status/health monitoring endpoints, remote configuration push via API, and independent developer confirmation of these capabilities.
